scenes.sub: You get bored faster than anyone you know.
The fastest planet in the sky.

scenes.text:
You can talk to *anyone*.
About anything.

scenes.sub: Same job, same city, same food. You need change.
Travel, trade, new places. Mercury rewards motion.

scenes.caption: *Wednesday* is your day. *Green* is your colour.

scenes.text:
Comment *5* if you
made it this far
